item.title: After abysmal MNF effort by Wentz, O'Connell defers QB trade query to Vikings GM
item.description: After a historically poor performance by Carson Wentz on Monday night, Vikings coach Kevin O'Connell was asked whether the team might trade for a QB ahead of Tuesday's deadline. He deferred the question to GM Nolan Teasley. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Wembanyama scores 40 points in 25 minutes as Spurs win 9th straight
item.description: Victor Wembanyama finished with 40 points, 11 rebounds and nine blocks in just 25 minutes Monday night to lead the Spurs past the Suns 122-96 for their ninth straight win. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Jags acquire Eagles DT Davis in blockbuster; 3rd trade to boost defense
item.description: The Jaguars traded a 2027 first-round pick and a 2029 second-round pick to the Eagles for defensive tackle Jordan Davis on Monday. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Nacua (knee, toe) likely to hit IR; Rams to explore 'all avenues' before trade deadline
item.description: Los Angeles Rams wide receiver Puka Nacua is likely going on injured reserve due to an MCL/PCL sprain as well as turf toe, according to coach Sean McVay. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Warriors, told 'PASS TO STEPH' by Butler dressed as coach, win 8th straight by 51
item.description: Stephen Curry scored 25 points in 20-plus minutes, Yaxel Lendeborg added 23 points, and the Warriors won their eighth straight game by 51 points against the short-handed Pelicans on Monday night. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Tigers SS Kevin McGonigle, Reds 1B Sal Stewart win MLB's rookie of year awards
item.description: Detroit Tigers shortstop Kevin McGonigle, 22, won the American League Rookie of the Year award Monday night in a televised presentation, moments before Cincinnati Reds first baseman Sal Stewart, 22, was honored as the National League Rookie of the Year. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Sources: USMNT's Poch favored for United job with Carrick exit imminent
item.description: United States coach Mauricio Pochettino is the favoured candidate to replace Michael Carrick as Manchester United manager, sources have told ESPN. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Belichick's ex-girlfriend Jordon Hudson sues over 2023 Ring cam video
item.description: Bill Belichick's ex-girlfriend, Jordon Hudson, has filed a civil complaint against two Airbnb hosts over a 2023 video of the coach without a shirt at the property. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Allen leads Bills to win over tough Vikings defense
item.description: The Vikings kept Allen in check for much of the game, but he helped the Bills earn a low-scoring victory. Source: ESPN.

item.title: The historic (and absurd) longevity of Steph Curry and Kevin Durant
item.description: More than 10 years after briefly joining forces, Steph and KD remain near the top of their games at 38. How long can each legend keep this up? Source: ESPN.

item.description: England are into the Wheelchair Rugby League World Cup final after thrashing Australia 86-18 - but still have not hit peak form, according to try-scorer Rob Hawkins. Source: BBC Sport.
